title: How to stake Ethereum starting from 0.1 ETH with Everstake Staking Dashboard
text: [0:01] Speaker 1: In this video, we'll show you how to stake Ethereum using the Everstake staking dashboard. To get started, click the "Connect Wallet" button. Next, choose the wallet you want to use. In this example, we'll connect the MetaMask wallet. Once your wallet is connected, the dashboard will display your available Ethereum balance. Now enter the amount of Ethereum you would like to stake. Please note that the minimum staking amount is 0.1 Ethereum. You can also click "Stake Max" to automatically select the maximum available amount. Before continuing, make sure to read and accept the terms and conditions by checking the box. When everything is ready, click "Stake Now." Then confirm the transaction in your wallet. After the transaction is confirmed, your tokens will be successfully staked, and you will start earning rewards based on the current reward rate. You can track it on the dashboard.
